source: BASE instructions and goal predicates checked against LIBERO scene definitions; evaluation split and perturbation scope from the current paper, October 7, 2026.

libero_spatial-0.title: Bowl between plate and ramekin
libero_spatial-0.description: Identify the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin, then transfer that bowl to the plate. The spatial relation selects the intended object.
libero_spatial-0.objects: Akita black bowl, plate, ramekin and surrounding scene objects.
libero_spatial-0.focus: Spatial reference resolution and goal-directed pick-and-place.
steps: Locate the bowl described by the between relation.
Grasp and transport the selected bowl.
Place the bowl on the plate.
libero_spatial-0.success: The target black bowl is on the plate.
libero_spatial-0.exclusionReason: Object position swap is not applicable to the Spatial evaluation tasks.

libero_spatial-8.title: Bowl next to plate
libero_spatial-8.description: Select the black bowl next to the plate and move it onto the plate. The intended bowl must remain identifiable when scene conditions change.
libero_spatial-8.objects: Akita black bowl, plate and surrounding scene objects.
libero_spatial-8.focus: Spatial reference resolution under changes to layout and perception.
steps: Identify the bowl next to the plate.
Grasp the target and move toward the receiving plate.
Place the bowl on the plate.
libero_spatial-8.success: The target black bowl is on the plate.
libero_spatial-8.exclusionReason: Object position swap is not applicable to the Spatial evaluation tasks.

libero_object-1.title: Cream cheese into basket
libero_object-1.description: Find the cream cheese among the scene objects and transfer it into the basket. Object identity determines what should be picked.
libero_object-1.objects: Cream cheese, basket and surrounding scene objects.
libero_object-1.focus: Object recognition, grasping and placement into a receiving region.
steps: Identify and grasp the cream cheese.
Transport it to the basket.
Place it inside the basket's containment region.
libero_object-1.success: The cream cheese is inside the basket's containment region.

libero_object-8.title: Chocolate pudding into basket
libero_object-8.description: Select the chocolate pudding and put it into the basket, keeping the target identity and receiving region consistent under perturbation.
libero_object-8.objects: Chocolate pudding, basket and surrounding scene objects.
libero_object-8.focus: Object selection and pick-and-place under instance and appearance changes.
steps: Identify and grasp the chocolate pudding.
Transport it to the basket.
Place it inside the basket's containment region.
libero_object-8.success: The chocolate pudding is inside the basket's containment region.

libero_goal-3.title: Bowl into top drawer
libero_goal-3.description: Open the top drawer of the wooden cabinet and put the bowl into it. Accessing the receiver and placing the object form a dependent manipulation sequence.
libero_goal-3.objects: Akita black bowl and wooden cabinet with a top drawer.
steps: Open the top drawer to make its receiving region accessible.
Grasp and transport the bowl.
Place the bowl inside the top drawer.
libero_goal-3.success: The bowl is inside the cabinet's top receiving region. Drawer opening is part of the instructed sequence; the BASE goal checks bowl containment.

libero_goal-6.title: Cream cheese on bowl
libero_goal-6.description: Move the cream cheese onto the black bowl. The published BASE instruction uses the relation on, and the task goal uses the corresponding On predicate.
libero_goal-6.objects: Cream cheese and akita black bowl.
libero_goal-6.focus: Goal-conditioned placement and the required object-to-object relation.
steps: Locate the cream cheese and receiving bowl.
Grasp and transport the cream cheese.
Place it on the bowl so the required relation holds.
libero_goal-6.success: The cream cheese satisfies the On relation with the black bowl.

libero_10-5.title: Book into back compartment
libero_10-5.description: Pick up the black book and place it in the back compartment of the desk caddy. The receiving compartment, rather than the entire caddy, defines the destination.
libero_10-5.objects: Black book and compartmentalized desk caddy.
steps: Locate the book and the caddy's back compartment.
Grasp and orient the book for the receiving compartment.
Place the book inside the back containment region.
libero_10-5.success: The black book is inside the caddy's back containment region.

libero_10-8.title: Both moka pots on stove
libero_10-8.description: Place both moka pots on the stove. The BASE success condition additionally requires the stove to be switched on, so completing only one placement is insufficient.
libero_10-8.objects: Two moka pots and a flat stove with a cooking region and switch.
libero_10-8.focus: Multi-object completion and maintaining all goal conditions.
steps: Identify both moka pots and the stove's cooking region.
Move each pot onto the cooking region.
Ensure the stove is on and both placements still satisfy the goal.
libero_10-8.success: Both moka pots are on the stove's cooking region and the stove is on. All three predicates must hold.
libero_10-8.exclusionReason: The paper excludes distractor rearrangement for Long task 8 from the dynamic-evaluation denominator.
